original_question: Determine all integer pairs (x, y) that satisfy the Diophantine equation x^2 - x = y^5 - y.
self_contained_problem: Determine all pairs of integers (x, y) in Z x Z that satisfy the Diophantine equation x^2 - x = y^5 - y. That is, find every integer solution of the equation, and prove that the list is complete.

status_evidence.claim: The equation is listed as an open problem from a 2007 instructional workshop.
status_evidence.title: Some open problems about Diophantine equations

status_search_result: The equation appears as the first open problem in a 2007 Leiden/Lorentz Center workshop problem list on Diophantine equations. The fixture does not independently verify the global literature status; it preserves the dataset status as provisional intake metadata.
